reason: The README clearly describes a context-management plugin that structures conversation entries, indexes them, and selectively loads relevant context to reduce unnecessary token use.

summaries.zh: 一个将会话拆分为思考、工具调用和回复等类型化上下文，并通过目录与筛选机制按需加载内容的插件。
summaries.en: A plugin that splits conversations into typed context sections and selectively loads indexed entries through baseline, screening, and manual release mechanisms.

capabilities: Structures conversation context into typed sections
Indexes context entries and selectively releases relevant entries
Makes an optional text-only screening model call
Provides a context_release tool for manually releasing indexed entries
